body:
CALLINDRA
CR 5

XP 1,600
Elan oracle (inner flame oracle) 6
N Medium humanoid (aberrant)
Init +5; Senses clouded vision 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +5 armor)
hp 38 (6d8+6)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +7; +1 vs. psionic effects
Defensive Abilities resistance, resilience

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft. (30 ft. without armor)
Melee light mace +4 (1d6)
Ranged +1 light crossbow +6 (1d8/19–20)
Special Attacks psionic bulwark
Psionic Powers Known (ML 6th; concentration +9); 4 pp

1st—force screen
0th (at will)—blinding flash (DC 13), conceal thoughts (DC 13), detect psionics, energy splash (DC 13), missive

Oracle Spells Known (CL 6th; concentration +9)

3rd (4/day)—dispel magic
2nd (6/day)—eagle’s splendor, lesser restoration
1st (7/day)—bless, command, (DC 14), cure light wounds, memory lapse (DC 14), sanctuary
0th (at will)—detect magic, detect poison, guidance, purify food and drink, read magic, resistance, stabilize

Mystery Time

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 16
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 15
Feats Access Psionic Talent, Blind Fight, Craft Cognizance Crystal, Erosion of Will, Improved Initiative, Psionic Talent, Unlocked Talent
Skills Diplomacy +7, Knowledge (arcana) +5, Knowledge (psionics) +10, Perception +9, Sense Motive +5, Spellcraft +14, Use Magic Device +4; Racial Modifiers –1 to Charisma checks vs. non-elans
Languages Common, Elven
SQ naturally psionic, oracle’s curse (clouded vision), repletion, revelations (knowledge of the ages)
Gear holy water (2), potion of cure serious wounds (2), psiflare (3), +1 light crossbow, +2 studded leather armor, bag of holding (type I), book (The Invisible Art), light mace
